title: CTD Radial
description: A client-side Radial Menu that modders can depend on to add actions to their own mod.
body:
This mod allows other mod developers, when they add this mod as dependency, to create radial menus with ease. There may be other mods that do this, and do it much better than us, and that's cool, we can be the nth competing standard. xP

 

By default, **pressing R** will open the Radial menu whenever conditions are met. This key is configurable, of course. With this menu open, you will be able to select from options programmed by the mod developer. This can be as simple as opening another GUI, or perhaps sending a packet to the server to do other neat things.

 

It may take a while for mods to show up and use this mod as a depedency.
